newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche says Holzmann to retain identity.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche says Holzmann to retain identity.

text.p: Germany's Deutsche Bank AG said it and Hochtief AG planned to pool their shares in Philipp Holzmann AG in a blocking deposit but there were no plans to merge the two construction firms.
The bank also said it and Hochtief would vote jointly at Holzmann shareholder meetings but that Holzmann would retain its separate identity.
The statement was issued on Tuesday at a joint Deutsche and Hochtief news conference which was announced on Monday.
"Holzmann is to keep its separate identity," said Deutsche board member Carl Ludwig von Boehm-Bezing.
The deal between Deutsche and Hochtief is aimed at increasing Hochtief's control over its industry rival while sidestepping cartel office objections to a broader tie-up.
The deal is subject to EU Commission approval.
Deutsche has just under 21 percent of Holzmann's capital while Hochtief has 24.9 percent.
